title: Holiday Gift Guide 2026
summary: Find holiday gift ideas for 2026 with Backblaze’s favorite picks for tech lovers, gamers, home cooks, and everyone in between.
body_markdown:
The holidays start earlier every year. I saw a gingerbread house in a store before the Halloween candy was gone, and I’m pretty sure there’s a snowman out there somewhere that’s been up since October. Gift giving isn’t exactly my strong suit, so I did what any reasonable person would do and asked my coworkers. You get to benefit. Here’s the annual Backblaze Holiday Gift Guide for 2026, as proposed by a bunch of Backblazers (and a few picks from me, because the internet had opinions).


## Tech and Gadgets


### [Melo-D AI Guitar](https://tempolorguitar.com/)


*Picked by Data Center Operations*


It’s more than Guitar Hero and easier than actual guitar. This one lets a beginner make music without just typing a request into ChatGPT. Kids, teens, and the person who has everything will all get a kick out of it.


### [iFixit Essential Electronics Toolkit](https://www.ifixit.com/products/essential-electronics-toolkit)


*Picked by Systems Administrator*


Everything you need to fix the easy and most common problems with electronics. It’s perfect for the person who has stared at a cracked phone screen and thought, “I could probably do that.” Great for a coworker, a teen, or a partner. Worst case, they take apart something that was already broken.


### [Fujifilm Instax Camera](https://instax.com/mini12)


A camera that prints your photo right there in your hand, no phone required. In a world where we all have 40,000 photos we’ll never look at (and, thankfully, a backup of them), a single printed picture on the fridge hits differently.


## Toys and Games


### [Atari 2600+](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CG7LMFKY)


*Picked by Data Center Operations*


A retro throwback that plays your old cartridges, and unlike the original 2600, it works on HD TVs. Dig the cartridges you kept out of the garage and play like you’re a kid again. Go find some classics too. This one’s good for pretty much everyone on your list.


### [Nintendo Switch 2](https://www.nintendo.com/us/gaming-systems/switch-2/)


It’s the gift every gamer is hoping for, and a safe bet for kids, teens, and grown-ups who still say they’re “just going to play one more level.” If you’re shopping for a Nintendo fan, this is the one. Just don’t expect it to be a quick pickup. It’s popular for a reason.


### [NeeDoh Nice Cube](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BQZFVJTB)


It’s a squishy cube you can squeeze, stretch, and smush all day, and it always snaps back to its original shape. Great for fidgeters, stressed-out coworkers, and anyone who needs something to do with their hands in a long meeting. It also costs next to nothing, so the stocking stuffer problem is solved.


## Home and Kitchen


### [Ninja Digital Air Fry Pro Countertop Oven](https://www.amazon.com/clp/B08QZZY53M)


*Picked by Data Center Operations*


It toasts, fries, roasts, and then FLIPS UP so it takes about as much counter space as a toaster. If you’ve ever given half your kitchen to an appliance you use twice a month, you know why that matters. Good for a partner, a parent, or yourself.


### [Convertible Hand Truck / Dolly](https://www.homedepot.com/pep/Milwaukee-150-lbs-Vertical-Capacity-and-300-lbs-Horizontal-Capacity-Convertible-Truck-DC73333/207155104)


*Picked by Marketing Operations*


The least expected pick on the list, and a good one. It works as a hand truck or a dolly, and it’s handy for moving appliances, dorm move-in, loading band equipment, and plenty of non-industrial jobs. It folds down like a Transformer into something compact and easy to store. Give it to the friend who always gets asked to help people move, and then ask them to help you move.


## Outdoors and Travel


### [Garmin Fenix 9](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/newsroom/press-release/outdoor/garmin-expands-its-flagship-performance-smartwatch-lineup-with-fenix9-and-fenix9-pro/)


If the person on your list runs trail races, hikes for fun, or just likes knowing exactly how far they’ve gone, put this on your list. It’s a multisport GPS watch with a bright AMOLED display, built-in maps, and a battery that lasts for weeks instead of days, so it won’t die halfway through the weekend. It’s not a casual stocking stuffer (it starts at about $1,000), but for the person who has everything, or for the one who really, really needs to know their elevation gain, it’s the gift that gets used.


### [Black Diamond Spot 400 Headlamp](https://blackdiamondequipment.com/en_US/product/spot-400)


Headlamps are the unglamorous gift that ends up getting used constantly: camping, power outages, and walking the dog at 5 p.m. in December when it’s already pitch black. This one is small, bright, and comfortable enough that you forget you’re wearing it. Not flashy, just useful, which is the best kind of gift.


## Stuff You Can Wear


### [Darn Tough Merino Wool Hiking Socks](https://darntough.com/products/mens-merino-wool-hiker-boot-cushioned-midweight-hiking-socks)


Socks are the gift everyone pretends to be disappointed by and then secretly loves. These are made in Vermont from merino wool and come with a lifetime guarantee, so if they ever wear out, the company swaps them for a new pair. Warm, itch-free, and the kind of sock you’ll catch yourself bragging about.


### [Carhartt Knit Beanie](https://www.carhartt.com/product/A18)


A good beanie might be the perfect stocking stuffer. It fits pretty much everyone, it’s cheap enough to grab a couple, and nobody has ever said they own too many. The classic Carhartt one is warm, stretchy, and tough enough to survive a winter of being shoved into a coat pocket.


## Food and Drink


### [Graza Sizzle & Drizzle Olive Oil Gift Set](https://graza.co/products/gift-set-drizzle-sizzle)


Olive oil in a squeeze bottle sounds like a gimmick until you cook with it once. This duo gives you Sizzle for cooking and Drizzle for finishing, all in a gift box, so the person on your list can put olive oil on everything without a ceremony. It runs about $25 at Target, which makes it one of the easier gifts to feel good about.


### [Fishwife Tinned Fish](https://eatfishwife.com/products/smoked-atlantic-salmon)


Tinned fish went from the thing in your grandpa’s pantry to a legitimately fancy snack, and Fishwife is a big reason why. The tins come in good-looking packaging with things like smoked salmon and tuna, so it’s a gift that looks great and also works as dinner. Pair it with crackers and call it a charcuterie board.


## Everything Else


### **Gift Cards (Amazon, Bass Pro Shops, Target)**


*Picked by Infrastructure Operations, Data Center Teams*


They work for everyone and give people the flexibility to find something they actually like. For a coworker or Secret Santa, you can’t go wrong.

## Happy Gift-Giving From Backblaze


I hope this guide sparked an idea or two. Comment below and tell me what you’re picking up for the people on your list this year (we won’t tell them).
